text: Since 2026-10-11 11:37 UTC, the research agent used company data without confirming it was the right company, with no errors or crashes. The v3 prompt deleted the Identify step that verified the company record belonged to the requested domain, so enrichment ran without confirmation and triggered tw_company_match_skipped. Proposed fix 1: Restore the Identify confirmation step so the enrichment record is only used once its primary domain is verified against the requested domain, keeping the rest of the v3 wording; when the domain lookup returns no record or the domain does not match, the agent must leave company_match_confirmed false and describe no company. On 10 simulated variants, the failing cases went from 1 of 7 passing to 7 of 7, and 3 of 3 healthy cases stayed correct. Say "approve fix 1" to merge it.
